reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I confirmed that the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 100 seats and that this replaces the number in her #north-team post from this morning.

She asked for no action, so I only replied. I didn't read #north-team, and I didn't repeat the earlier wrong number in #north-random. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, and she had already posted it in that channel herself, so repeating it there was fine.
